description_preview:
**About Moder**
 Moder is an AI\-enabled, human\-powered digital services company built for mortgage, insurance, and financial services. We meet clients where they are, tackle the toughest industry challenges, and build solutions that hold up in production environments where the stakes are real. Our partnership with Palantir brings Foundry and AIP to clients who need to move from AI experimentation to operational reality.
   

  

 We have served clients across the full mortgage lifecycle — from origination through capital markets — and are now expanding that same operational depth into insurance and broader financial services. We RAISE the bar every day: Results, Accountability, Innovation, Service, Excellence.
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 Moder is building its first cohort of Forward Deployment Engineers and we are doing it intentionally, carefully, and with you at the center of the design. The FDE Fellowship Program is a full\-time, structured launch pad for recent graduates who want to do more than start a career. We are looking for people who want to help build one. Fellows in this Cohort will be the first people to go through “Foundry Academy”, the first to deploy on live client engagements, the first to stress\-test our training curriculum, and the first to tell us what works and what doesn't. Your feedback will directly shape how Moder trains, develops, and grows FDEs for years to come. That is not a responsibility we take lightly and it is not an opportunity that comes around often. This program is for engineers who are technically sharp and genuinely curious about how AI gets deployed in the real world, not in demos, but inside financial institutions with messy data, legacy systems, and high stakes. If you want to understand how AI changes how a business operates, this is where that learning happens.
   

  

*Fellows are not observers. They are contributors. From week one, you will be working on real problems, inside real platforms, alongside experienced engineers who are counting on your thinking — not just your output.*
**What Makes This Different**
 Most early\-career programs rotate you through assignments until someone decides you are ready for real work. This is not that. Here is what you are actually signing up for:
   

  

**You Build the Playbook**
 Cohort 1 doesn't follow a fully established program — they help create it. Your experience, your feedback, and your capstone work will directly shape Moder's FDE onboarding, training curriculum, and deployment methodology. Future cohorts will learn from what you build.
   

  

**Hybrid in Philadelphia — Rooted, Not Remote**
 You will work from Moder's Philadelphia hub at least three days per week. This is intentional. The best learning happens in proximity — with mentors in the same room, on whiteboards, in real\-time conversations. You will also travel periodically to client sites, which means your context for the work is always grounded in reality, not theory.
   

  

**A Rare Combination Of Technical And Human Skills**
 FDE work sits at the intersection of engineering and client relationships. You will build data pipelines and you will present them to a CFO. You will configure AI workflows and you will train the people who use them. The combination of technical depth and communication clarity is rare — and we will develop both deliberately.
   

  

**A Career Path That Is Already Designed**
 The Fellowship is the entry point to the FDE track. There is no ambiguity about where it leads. Fellows who perform become Associate FDEs. The path from there is clear: Associate FDE → FDE → Senior FDE → Principal FDE. Advancement is tied to what you deliver, not how long you have been here.
   

  

**You Will Be Inquisitive — And Rewarded for It**
 We are not looking for people who wait to be told what to explore. The engineers who thrive here ask the uncomfortable question in the client meeting, chase the anomaly in the data no one asked them to investigate, and push back on assumptions with evidence. Curiosity is not a soft skill here — it is a job requirement. We will actively create space for it.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Fellows work across three interconnected areas simultaneously. These are not phases — they happen together, from the beginning.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Platform Engineering**
* Work on active Palantir Foundry deployments alongside senior FDEs, owning defined scopes within real client engagements — not sandbox projects.
* Build data pipelines, ontology structures, and workflow automations in Foundry's Pipeline Builder and Workshop — moving from supported execution to independent delivery as your confidence builds.
* Wrangle real, complex financial services datasets: cleaning, transforming, integrating, and making them usable inside Palantir's ontology layer. The data will not be clean. That is the point.
* Develop hands\-on proficiency in Foundry's core tools: Pipeline Builder, Workshop, Ontology Manager, Code Repositories, and AIP.
* Contribute to architecture and technical design discussions — your perspective as someone newer to the platform is genuinely valuable, not just tolerated.
* Build working familiarity with AI and LLM\-driven workflows through Palantir AIP, understanding where AI adds real operational value and where it doesn't.


**Client Engagement \& Collaboration**
* Participate in client\-facing sessions — discovery meetings, technical reviews, status updates — alongside senior FDEs, learning and contributing from the first month.
* Support training and handoff sessions for client teams, helping communicate what has been built and why it works the way it does.
* Develop the ability to translate technical realities into business language across a range of audiences, from data analysts to C\-suite executives.
* Represent Moder in\-person at client locations when travel is required, carrying the kind of credibility that comes from actually knowing the work.


**Program Development \& Field Intelligence**
* Participate actively in Moder Academy — our structured onboarding covering the mortgage lifecycle, insurance operations, Palantir Foundry, and client engagement frameworks — and tell us honestly what is missing or unclear.
* Maintain a structured learning log throughout the Fellowship, capturing client patterns, platform observations, and deployment insights that feed directly back to Moder's product and training teams.
* Complete a capstone project — a client\-facing workflow or internal accelerator that you own end\-to\-end — and present it to Moder leadership at the close of your Fellowship period.
* Provide formal feedback at structured checkpoints that will be used to improve the program for Cohort 2\. Your candor is valued, not just encouraged.


**Other Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* Comply with all company policies and procedures.
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance.


**What We Are Looking For**
*We are not looking for the most experienced candidate. We are looking for the most curious one — with the technical foundation to do real work and the disposition to thrive in environments that are still being defined.*
**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
   

  

**Required**
* Recent graduate (undergraduate or graduate) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Programming ability in Python — you write it independently, not just read it. Data manipulation, API calls, scripting, and a working understanding of how data moves between systems.
* Working SQL proficiency for querying and exploring datasets; comfort working with structured data at meaningful scale.
* A highly analytical mindset: you break problems down, find the data that matters, and build a structured case for what to do — rather than waiting for direction.
* High degree of intellectual curiosity and inquisitiveness — you ask questions others skip past, investigate the edges of problems, and are never fully satisfied with 'it works.'
* Clear communication in writing and in conversation, to both technical and non\-technical audiences. We will assess this directly in the interview process.
* Comfort with ambiguity and open\-ended environments where what you need to do is discovered through engagement, not handed down in a spec.
* Ability to commute to and work from Philadelphia at least three days per week.


**Preferred**
* Coursework, projects, or research involving data engineering, machine learning, enterprise data platforms, or applied AI. Foundry experience is rare at this level — curiosity and technical aptitude matter far more.
* Any exposure to AI/ML concepts including LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agentic systems — enough to understand why they matter in an enterprise context.
* Prior experience in a client\-facing, consulting, or applied research capacity — you have translated between technical work and a non\-technical audience before.
* Background or coursework in financial services, mortgage, insurance, or a regulated industry. You do not need to be an expert — an informed curiosity is enough.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) at any level.


**What's In It For You**
 We know you have options. Here is why Fellows choose Moder:
   

  

**Ownership from Day One**
 You will not spend your first months observing. You will be given defined ownership over real scopes within live client engagements. When something ships, your name is on it.
   

  

**Training That Is Actually Designed Around You**
 Moder Academy is a comprehensive onboarding program covering the mortgage and insurance lifecycle, Palantir Foundry platform certification, and Moder's client engagement framework. As a Cohort 1 Fellow, you also get to improve it. If something is missing or unclear, we want to know — and we will fix it.
   

  

**A Mentor Who Is Actually Invested**
 Every Fellow is paired with a dedicated senior FDE from day one. Weekly 1:1s, structured feedback, and real mentorship — not a name on an org chart. Your mentor's goal is to help you get to Associate FDE, and their success is tied to yours.
   

  

**Philadelphia Presence — Built\-In Community**
 The hybrid model is not a compromise — it is a feature. Three days in the office means you are in the same room as the team, learning through proximity, building relationships that remote work cannot replicate. Philadelphia is also a growing hub for financial services technology, and being embedded in that environment matters for your career.
   

  

**A Career Path With No Guesswork**
 The Fellowship is the explicit entry point to the FDE track. Strong performance converts directly to an Associate FDE offer. The path after that is written down, not implied: Associate FDE → FDE → Senior FDE → Principal FDE. Your advancement is tied to what you deliver, not how long you wait.
   

  

**The Chance To Shape What Comes Next**
 Cohort 1 Fellows will have more influence over Moder's FDE program than any group that follows. The playbooks you help build, the feedback you provide, and the standards you set will define what Moder looks for and how it develops engineers for years. That is a real legacy.
   

  

**About The Fde Fellowship \& Career Path**
*The FDE Fellowship is not a trial period — it is the beginning of a career track. Cohort 1 Fellows who perform will receive Associate FDE offers. The track beyond that is clear and merit\-based.*
**The Full Path**
**FDE Fellow → Associate FDE → FDE → Senior FDE → Principal FDE**
 Advancement is tied to client outcomes, technical depth, and the quality of insight you bring back to Moder's product and training teams — not to time in seat. The best FDEs at Moder shape what we build next. That starts in the Fellowship.

Who We Are
   

  

 Voxel is building the future of Computer Vision and Machine Learning for operations, risk, and safety. We use computer vision and AI to enable existing security cameras to automatically detect hazards and high\-risk activities, keep people safe and drive operational efficiencies. Our technology addresses the key cost drivers for workers’ compensation, general liability, and property damage, which cost US employers over $500 billion annually.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and bright engineer to join our team and devise elegant solutions to challenging problems. This role will focus on designing and implementing systems to support Voxel's ML development. As a part of the perception team, you should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment and solving problems across the software stack. We require engineers to be versatile and possess the ability to move across projects and tackle new challenges.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and productionize state\-of\-the\-art computer vision algorithms for object detection, tracking, pose estimation, activity recognition, and anomaly detection in complex indoor environments like warehouses and retail spaces.
* Implement and optimize computer vision techniques for high\-throughput, low\-latency applications on edge compute devices.
* Streamline ML data ingestion, retraining pipelines, and model redeployment workflows.
* Build and maintain reliable, scalable pipelines for continuous training and deployment of ML models in production environments.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Field Engineering to architect ML\-driven solutions tailored to customer needs and deployment contexts.


**Qualifications**
 Must\-Haves
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics or a related field.
* Software development experience with proficiency in Python, Go\-Lang or C\+\+.
* Ability to solve complex and open\-ended problems
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git (e.g., branching, merging, pull requests).


 Nice\-to\-Haves
   

  

* Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
* Coursework or research in computer vision or machine learning.
* 1\-3 years of experience in software development.
* Experience with Docker, Bazel build system and/or AWS cloud services like EKS, S3, ECS
* Experience designing large, highly available distributed systems with Kubernetes.
* Experience working with monocular cameras \- pose estimation, tracking and state estimation, object detection, segmentation.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 Join a visionary team revolutionizing safety and operations, directly impacting the well\-being of millions of essential workers. This is your chance to build an extraordinary business and foster a vibrant company culture that demands your absolute best. Alongside AI experts, experienced entrepreneurs, and passionate problem\-solvers, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the company's growth trajectory and market position. Enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and a dynamic work environment.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Extensive / Generous health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Highly competitive paid parental leave and support system.
* Ownership in the business through an Equity Incentive Plan.
* Generous paid time off and / or flexible work arrangements.
* Daily meals in\-office, vibrant company events, team\-building.
* 401K retirement plan, HSA options, pre\-tax Commuter Card.

 Must have the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team, with a problem solving and an innovative mindset. Continuously demonstrate organizational skills and ability to prioritize. Must be able to collect, organize, and document detailed information.
   

  

 Basic working knowledge of UiPath will be necessary to work with business SMEs, this individual will capture inputs/outputs, rules, exceptions, dependencies, systems and applications necessary to initiate solution and design documents creating the configuration of UiPath framework of the automation process. In addition, the Associate Engineer will create clear user guides and basic technical documentation for automation processes to support adoption and training.
   

  

 The Associate Business Process Automation Engineer will work under the supervision of the EDA team to adhere to the solution and process design documents to build less complex automation processes on the UiPath platform. Including the configuring UiPath orchestrator queues, credentials, triggers, to enable deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and also responding to execution alerts remediating failed jobs. Supporting the Hypercare phase and stabilizing automations post go\-live.  Bachelor's Degree required in Data Science or Computer Science.

 UiPath Developer Certification within 1 year

description_preview:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we’re transforming intangible ideas into innovative solutions designing the future \- today. As an Entry Level Structural Tunnel Engineer with our team in Boston or New York Metro Area, you will too. You'll impact the world around you by helping us solve real\-life challenges. YOU are the future of our company. We’ll rely on you to provide support to our teams on critical projects while fostering a culture of continuous learning and inclusion as you bring fresh ideas to the table. You’ll work alongside professional engineers, scientists, and designers while gaining exposure to project coordination, relevant computer\-assisted engineering software, data collection and so much more. Pave the way for your career with a company that inspires and empowers you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. The successful candidate(s) will become part of Jacobs’ tunnel engineering team working on planning, designing, and constructing tunnels and other underground structures across the US.
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to grow personally and professionally with each project. Jacobs’ Northeast tunnel group designs underground projects and supports construction. Recent projects and roles include
   

  

* Design and construction of tunnels and caverns by TBM, drill and blast, and SEM methods.
* Design of microtunnels and EPB TBM tunnels.
* Design and consulting for major upgrade to major US infrastructure projects.
* Engineering support for major tunnel construction projects.


 Representative Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Works under supervision of experienced tunnel engineers.
* Maintains effective communications with the engineering team and clients.
* Performs calculations to design excavation support and linings and shoring systems.
* Prepares design drawings and assist in specifications preparation.
* Prepares technical reports and presentations to present findings and recommendations.
* Reviews contractor construction submittals.
* Observes and reports on construction activities and ground conditions during construction.
* Performs field investigation as needed by the project.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Master’s degree in structural engineering
* Eligible to work in the United States
* Hybrid position – minimum 2 days in Jacobs’ office, preferably reporting to either our New York, New Jersey, or Boston office.
* Skilled in structural analysis and design, including experience using structural analysis and design software such as SAP2000, STAAD, spColumn,
* Proficiency in the interpretation and application of the following structural engineering codes and standards is a requirement ACI\-318; AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications; ASCE 7 Minimum Design Loads.
* Additional experience with the following structural codes and standards is preferred AWS D1\.1 Structural Welding Code; AREMA.
* Willingness to perform periodic visits to construction sites (after being trained for site\-specific safety requirements).
* On track to obtain Professional Engineer license (e.g., already obtained Engineering\-in\-Training, on\-track to obtain PE within 3 to 4 years).
* CAD skills including AutoCAD, Civil3D, and possibly MicroStation.
* BIM skills such as Autodesk Revit or Bentley Systems equivalent preferred. Experience with Bentley Systems OpenTunnel would be an asset, though not required.
* Strong communication skills, both written and spoken
* Other software skills required include Microsoft Office (particularly MS Word, MS Excel, and PowerPoint).
* Other software skills preferred include ArcGIS, GoogleEarth, Matlab


 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full\-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.
   

  

 The base salary range for this position is $66,900\.00 to $89,000\.00\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on June 10, 2026\. This position will be open for at least 3 days.
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

**How long have you spent making one missile programme 10% better?** 




 That's something most engineers accept. Years of your career, one platform, incremental gains.
 



  





 Here's something different. Your algorithms shipping on dozens of platforms at once. A problem the entire industry hasn't cracked.
 



  





**The problem you'd be working on** 




 GNSS is being jammed and spoofed at scale, and there's no silver bullet to replace it. No single technology matches what satellite navigation provides, so the answer has to be blended:
 


* Hardened GNSS
* Inertial
* LEO satellite aiding
* and whatever you prove out next



  





 In this role, you'd own one of those development paths end to end. Research it, build it in MATLAB, test it against GNSS simulators and real\-world data coming back from fielded units, and drive it into customers' hands.
 



  





 Beta units with LEO satellite navigation aiding are shipping right now, so your work hits the field in months, not years. Even the most research\-heavy projects here are 2 years MAX from a customer.
 



  





 You'd join a team of 6 under the CTO. It's a senior role which exists because these paths need to move forward without the CTO reviewing every result. You be given an objective, and the autonomy to run with it.
 



  





**What you'll need** 




 3 things:
 


* A master's or PhD covering dynamics, control, and estimation (Kalman filtering is the heart of the work.
* \>10 years developing navigation algorithms from scratch, not tuning someone else's
* Enough programming fluency to work in MATLAB, even if you'd need to pick it up
